description:
When creating ticks in Step 3 of skill workflow:

- Apply detected project to all created epics and tasks
- Use -project flag on tk create commands
- Example: tk create "Auth System" -t epic -project "$DETECTED_PROJECT"

If no project detected, prompt user:
'No project code detected. Would you like to:
1. Generate a new project code (recommended)
2. Continue without a project code
3. Enter a project code manually'
